text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's phenomenal sprint!
A spectacular victory over Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She brings a victorious close to the fateful rivalry that has played out time and again this year!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you, everyone!
Thanks to you, it turned out to be a great year!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text: Go, Vodka, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan B
text_block_list.text: So strong! We're counting on you next year too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you must be feeling pretty great right now!
Playing the hero!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that felt totally refreshing.
Beating you, making the fans happy."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: However—that's all it is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The heat from back during the Derby just ain't there.
That feeling of my whole body burning up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh, back during the Derby... Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I beat you.
But... I lost to myself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Where I'm aiming isn't here.
'Cause I've realized
this isn't the "victory" I'm after.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "A win like this is... But a win is a win, isn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, but what I'm aiming for
isn't this."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Where me and my Trainer are aiming for, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, our match will have to wait.
I've got something I need to look for.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To a place only I can aim for.
—Later.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

"That day, Vodka showed no sign
of heading home..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Trainer. Keeping you out
this late and all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The lingering heat from this year won't cool down.
I wanna wash it all away and head into the new year.
choice_data_list: To become a cooler version of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I'm definitely glad
I ran in the Arima Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Beating her and getting praised by the fans still ain't enough.
'Cause I realized that what I want is something else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll have to search for it, together with you.

"Something" beyond mere glory.
It seems Vodka won't feel truly fulfilled without it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So... where should I aim first next year?
I want to make a fresh start.

"A fresh start... Vodka seems to want to search for
what she truly desires, what kind of running she seeks."

If so, rather than a medium or long distance with lots of tactical maneuvering,
a shorter distance where she can focus on pure running would be better.
If that is the case—
choice_data_list: What about the spring Victoria Mile?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "The Victoria Mile, huh... A straight-up battle of pure speed, no tactics involved."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's where we'll go. Until then,
keep me company on a little aimless cruise, alright?
There are different phases in a series. Times when you dash through without thinking, and times when you search for answers.

Without running away—
Vodka was about to charge headlong into a season of doubt.
